name: SLIDE WARMING TABLE
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Slide Warming Table provides controlled, even heat to dry and warm microscope slides for histology and cytology. It features a digital PID temperature controller and a PT100 sensor for precise temperature management, ensuring samples dry without artifacts.
features: Plain, even, and good finish SS304 hot surface
Ambient+10°C to 70°C overall temperature range with ±0.5°C accuracy
Fitted with microprocessor based digital PID temperature controller
Uniform heat distribution across the dimension via sealed heating elements

specifications.Controller: PID temperature controller with LED display and auto-tuning
